diffs.diff: header pin 3: part says PWM, datasheet reading says Signal
diffs.evidence: Label-only difference for the same conductor: both readings list GND, V+ and the control line in the same order with the same roles (gnd, power, io), and Adafruit #2307 describes that third lead as the pulse input, 'connecting the yellow control wire to pin 9 or 10 and using the Servo library', with 'Position "0" (1.5ms pulse) is middle', so 'PWM' and 'Signal' name the same 50 Hz pulse wire and no wiring or electrical change is needed.
